must_keep.quote: A mission (instruction to travel) (see section 2. Missions covered by a mission order ) is travel away from the place of employment solely in the intere sts of the service, on the instructions of a line manager or the appointing authority.
must_keep.why: a mission is travel solely in the interests of the service

must_keep.quote: A mission is travel away from the place of employment solely in the interests of the service, on the instructions of a line manager. It is normally paid for out of the budget. Missions must be covered by a mission order. Except in duly justified exceptional circums tances, the mission order is issued before the staff member leaves on mission.

design_notes: The guide covers missions (travel solely in the interests of the service, under a mission order) and authorised travel (212-213, 218-220, 384-387). A family holiday is neither: the agency buys no ticket.
